OAT-06/S26.title: Mark Encounter Complete with pending tasks: Delete Pending Tasks & Complete / Keep Tasks & Mark Complete / Cancel - which rows each writes
OAT-06/S26.detail: Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Seeded three note-ready Hospital charts (finished note, billing pre-computed), each with 'QA fin task one: repeat lactate' and 'QA fin task two: wound photo'; each opened on Pre-Round, then Post-Round > Mark Encounter Complete; the Pending Tasks dialog listed both tasks every time. Judged 10/11: checkpoints D1 / D2 / D3; D1 note_marked_complete = 1; D2 note_marked_complete = 1 and no task row; D3 'Cancel - go back' wrote nothing and chart 3 is still note-ready with both tasks open; rollup notesCompleted +2; no patient content in any row; no model call. FAILED (1 cell): D1 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' wrote 0 task_deleted rows (then: 2). The two tasks are gone from chart 1, but the only rows are pre_round_summary_opened and note_marked_complete: PostRoundTab.tsx:453-457 saves the done tasks through markComplete without logTaskTap, as the code read predicted; rollup tasksDeleted +0 (recorded). The case judges D1 against TFA-94514 AC 2; whether the bulk delete at completion should count as task deletions is open (OAT-06 Q6, TC-24 Q5): if Daniela rules it should not, this cell becomes a pass. Record-only: TC-17 step 4 behaviour (TFA-92595, in progress: todo) - D1 removed only chart 1's pending tasks, D2 kept both open; minutesFromPreRoundOpened 0 on both completions. This run also gives the record TC-24/S29 (c) asks for: the bulk delete writes no task row.
OAT-06/S26.productIssue: Nothing looks wrong to the physician: 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' completes the encounter and removes the pending tasks. But the pilot analytics never record those deletions: no task_deleted row is written and pilotDailyRounding.tasksDeleted does not move, so the task-deletion numbers Vikram reads miss every task a physician clears at completion (TFA-94514 AC 2; open question Q6).
